item.title: Tomodachi Life: Living The Dream Nintendo Direct Announced For Thursday, 29th January
item.description: Dream Land.If last weekend's Mario Movie Direct wasn't enough for you, Nintendo has today announced that Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream will be getting a Direct presentation of its own later this week.As revealed on Nintendo Today!, the presentation will kick off on Thursday 29th January at 2pm GMT, and promises to clue us in on all kinds of hot new details about the long-awaited 3DS sequel throughout its 20-minute runtime.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.description: In certain parts of the world.Yesterday, Nintendo finally gave us our first look at Yoshi in The Super Mario Galaxy Movie, thanks to a Nintendo Direct and a brand new trailer. And while Yoshi — and some other Mario series cameos — stole the spotlight, there's one piece of additional news that fans in certain countries can get excited about.The Super Mario Bros. item.title: NYXI's Hyperion 3 Is, On Paper, The Perfect Joy-Con 2 Alternative
item.description: Early-bird price expires today.Over the coming years, we're likely to see a bunch of alternatives to the Switch 2's Joy-Con, but NYXI's new Hyperion 3 looks like it might be a solid early contender.Available for pre-order now via the NYXI website, you can currently take advantage of a 30% 'early-bird' discount, bringing the price down to £88 for those in the UK. This is only valid for the remainder of the day, by which point the price will return to £125.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: WarioWare's Original Soundtrack Has Been Added To Nintendo Music
item.description: It's Wario time!Nintendo Music has already added a Fire Emblem, Mario & Luigi and Zelda soundtrack this year, and a new update today sees the arrival of the original WarioWare album.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Kirby Air Riders Has Been Updated To Version 1.3.0, Here Are The Full Patch Notes
item.description: GameShare support and much more!We recently heard how Kirby Air Riders would be getting its first update of 2026 (and possibly last major game update).Well, the day is now here, and Version 1.3.0 has officially gone live on the Switch 2. To start with, GameShare is now supported - so you can play with a friend without a copy of the game. Along with this is a long list of balance adjustments to the riders and machines. item.description: The 'Woolhaven' expansion has arrived.:Every developer is rushing to get their last announcements of 2025 out the door, and with this in mind, the team behind Cult of the Lamb has today locked in a date for their new expansion, which will be dropping on Switch and multiple other platforms.Read the full article on nintendolife.com
